why: P0 (STATUS 13438; journeys r3-after-switch-traced and r3-e2-reattach): the daemon's pane that takes Cmd-N's stand-in over takes the stand-in's selection in the hand-over itself. What it carries is PaneController's own state (the strip's selected tab and its pending select; TabStripModel and PaneController are App-only types), so the carry in PaneController.init, the successor lookup and its select forward are App lines; the store part, DaemonStore.daemonPane(takingOver:), is in CmuxNextDaemon. The CMD-N FIRST FRAME stand-in view reuse (agent ae24e392dc421c938), which keeps one controller across the hand-over, removes these lines.
